title: EPILOGUE // ICE AND STEEL
narrative: In the eye of the blizzard, Jon Snow meets the King of the Others blade to blade. Valyrian steel rings against ancient frost with a resonance that shakes the mountains. With a final dying surge of Stark and Targaryen will, Longclaw finds its mark. The ice shatters. The army of the dead collapses into silent mounds of bone. Dawn breaks over the realm.
